brt-cavalry-emp-assault.title: Cavalry assault
brt-cavalry-emp-assault.question: Can an AI get its cavalry past the defenders and reach the guns?
brt-cavalry-emp-assault.challenge: Six mounted units face eight enemy units: four halberd units screening two units of handgunners and a cannon. The attacker must defeat the defenders before the 20-minute timer runs out.

brt-cavalry-emp-assault-hard.title: Cavalry assault, stronger enemy (AI stats ×1.1)
brt-cavalry-emp-assault-hard.question: Can an AI get its cavalry past the defenders and reach the guns?
brt-cavalry-emp-assault-hard.challenge: Six mounted units face eight enemy units: four halberd units screening two units of handgunners and a cannon. The attacker must defeat the defenders before the 20-minute timer runs out.

skv-swarm-dwf-line.title: Command a Skaven swarm
skv-swarm-dwf-line.question: Can an AI turn a horde of expendable rats into a win against a Dwarf gun line?
skv-swarm-dwf-line.challenge: Twenty Skaven units, most of them cheap and quick to flee, attack nine Dwarf units holding a gun line. The attacker must break the defenders before the 20-minute timer runs out.

dwf-line-skv-swarm.title: Survive a Skaven swarm
dwf-line-skv-swarm.question: Can an AI hold a small Dwarf line against a Skaven horde?
dwf-line-skv-swarm.challenge: Seven Dwarf units face twenty attacking Skaven units. The defender wins if it is still holding when the 20-minute timer runs out.

wh_main_brt_cha_lord_4.name: Lord
wh_main_brt_cha_lord_4.about: The army's leader: one character on horseback with combat abilities, not a regiment.

wh_main_brt_cav_knights_of_the_realm.name: Knights of the Realm
wh_main_brt_cav_knights_of_the_realm.about: Charge cavalry: built for the impact of the charge; weaker than the Questing Knights in a long melee.

wh_dlc07_brt_cav_questing_knights_0.name: Questing Knights
wh_dlc07_brt_cav_questing_knights_0.about: Built for sustained melee rather than the charge: higher melee attack and weapon damage, but a smaller charge bonus than the Knights of the Realm.

wh_main_brt_cav_grail_knights.name: Grail Knights
wh_main_brt_cav_grail_knights.about: The best knights here: the heaviest armour and steadiest morale in the army, and the strongest charge of any regiment.

wh_main_brt_cav_mounted_yeomen_1.name: Mounted Yeomen Archers
wh_main_brt_cav_mounted_yeomen_1.about: The fastest unit here: horse archers that shoot from up to 125 m with limited arrows, and are fragile in melee.

wh_main_emp_cha_general_0.name: General of the Empire
wh_main_emp_cha_general_0.about: The enemy's leader: one character on foot, as slow as its infantry.

wh_main_emp_inf_halberdiers.name: Halberdiers
wh_main_emp_inf_halberdiers.about: Slow, steady polearm infantry screening the guns; the scenario sets them as the anti-cavalry line, where a frontal fight risks a losing grind.

wh_main_emp_inf_handgunners.name: Handgunners
wh_main_emp_inf_handgunners.about: Ranged infantry: dangerous from up to 145 m, weak in melee.

wh_main_emp_art_great_cannon.name: Great Cannons
wh_main_emp_art_great_cannon.about: Long-range cannon (450 m) firing armour-piercing shot; its crew is very weak in melee.

highlights.title: Opening plan: around the west side
highlights.text: The first orders sent all six units on a two-leg route to the north-west, with the Lord and three knight regiments then to attack the cannon and handgunners; the model's stated reason: “Swing the cavalry west of the central obstruction to strike the cannon and handgunners from the flank.”

highlights.title: The long way round
highlights.text: Saying the halberdiers were “moving into the direct approach”, the model sent the Lord and knights wider, west at 1:08 and then north around Halberdiers 4 at 2:19, and the Lord reached the Great Cannons from the north at 3:13 with no men lost after 1:08.

highlights.title: The gun line flees first
highlights.text: The Great Cannons crew began fleeing at 3:27 after the Lord and Questing Knights reached it, and both Handgunners units at 3:46 with four mounted units fighting them, while none of the four Halberdiers units had fled yet.

highlights.title: Archer moves rejected, then rerouted
highlights.text: Two eastward moves for the Mounted Yeomen Archers were rejected as unreachable at 4:11 and 4:26; each time the game listed nearby reachable points and the model's next order used one, costing an extra 4–5 s decision with Halberdiers 3 within 70 m.

highlights.title: The general flees and the battle ends
highlights.text: In melee from 4:05 and fighting the Lord and all four knight regiments by 6:05, the General of the Empire began fleeing at 6:21; the three Halberdiers units still fighting followed within 1.2 s, and the game declared the win at 6:22.

highlights.title: Just-issued orders shown as “stopped”
highlights.text: The first update after the opening orders, taken the instant they took effect, described all six units as “stopped” 300–350 m short of their moves; the model replied “The first moves stopped short” and re-issued every route at 0:20, 0:30 and 0:38.

highlights.title: Same route, slower collapse
highlights.text: As in the selected example, the Lord circled north and reached the Great Cannons (at 3:15 here), but the gun line fled later: the cannon at about 3:44 and the last Handgunners unit (Handgunners 1) at about 4:22.

highlights.title: Withdrawal moves rejected
highlights.text: From 6:01 the game rejected cavalry moves as unreachable (the model's stated reason: “disengage the cavalry before the fresh halberdiers arrive”); the next reply used the reachable points the game listed, but rejections recurred until 8:44, 22 in all.
